text:
sophia: Heads-up — onboarding smoke run for magnet-14b-int8v2 across long-context / KV bridge. Brief run: priming 3.2k tokens, then append 500 token continuation. Observed divergence starting ~+120 tokens into continuation (outputs semantically drift).

omar: Can you paste seed prompt + the model config you used? quant/profile + rope scaling flags?

sophia: Config: `--quant=int8v2 --rope-mode=scaled --rope-base=10000 --max-kv-window=4096 --kv-prefetch=on`
Prompt excerpt: `System: You are an assistant...` then long doc (~3.2k) + query.

sophia: quick log snippet: ```
[2026-03-20T15:12:01Z] priming complete (3224 tokens)
[2026-03-20T15:12:02Z] continuation start
[2026-03-20T15:12:45Z] token 120: "and the resulting"
[2026-03-20T15:12:46Z] token 121: "blueprint is"
[2026-03-20T15:12:47Z] token 122: "not relevant to" <-- unexpected topic shift
```

lee: Interesting. Do you see the same with float16 baseline (no quant)?

sophia: float16 baseline keeps coherence. This looks quant+rope interaction or KV index wrap. Re-ran with `--rope-base=65536` and drift delayed to ~+360 tokens.

ana: @sophia can you try disabling kv-prefetch? If prefetch misaligns indices between priming and in-flight continuation we could get off-by-one mapping.

sophia: Will try now. Also adding run with `--kv-index-check=on` to log key checksums.

dev-bot: Deployment note: canary worker pool 7 used (g4dn.12xlarge). Test id 20260320-smoke-17 attached.

omar: If disabling prefetch fixes it we should add a guard: during quant bring-up, enforce strict KV index checksum validation on any prefetched state. Also record per-layer rot-pos deltas.

lee: Another angle: tokenization boundary. Does the drift always appear at the same continuation-relative offset? If yes, could be rope phase aliasing with quant rounding.

sophia: It's consistent within a run; offsets vary by rope-base but highly reproducible per config. I pushed artifacts to gs://redwood-evals/magnet-14b-int8v2/4300001111/ — including kv checksums.

ana: I'll grep the checksums for mismatch points. If it's index mapping, we expect a pattern where layer N's key checksum flips at the same continuation index.

lee: Also try `--kv-window=8192` with window tiling enabled. If it's wrap/tiling boundary that's visible.

sophia: queued those runs. ETA ~10m. For now, adding a short repro script in case we need to share: ```bash
python tools/repro_longctx.py \
  --model magnet-14b-int8v2 \
  --rope-base 10000 \
  --quant int8v2 \
  --priming-file longdoc.txt \
  --append-file query.txt \
  --log-kv-checksums out/checksums.log
```

omar: Great. If this is quant rounding interacting with RoPE, we should also compare per-layer QKV float deltas vs baseline. Maybe use a diff harness that computes cosine similarity of attention keys pre/post quant for the priming tokens.

sophia: Added that to pipeline. Will pull first failure artifacts in ~15m and summarize.

lee: Thanks. If you hit a deterministic repro, mark as P0 and ping eng-runtime — this could impact any long-context quant bring-up. :exclamation:

sophia: Will report back here with checksums + minimal repro. :thumbsup:
